PUT.desc: put an object (arg1) in/on another object (arg2), or give an object (arg1) to another agent (arg2)

TALK.desc: Talk to an agent, or open the controls of a device listed as an agent in nearbyAgents. Device controls use dialogue options. arg1 is its UUID.

USE.desc: use an object (arg1), e.g. a thermometer, on another object (arg2), e.g. water.

MOVE_DIRECTION.desc: move in a specific direction (arg1), which is one of 'north', 'east', 'south', or 'west'.

ROTATE_DIRECTION.desc: rotate to face a specific direction (arg1), which is one of 'north', 'east', 'south', or 'west'.

TELEPORT_TO_LOCATION.desc: teleport to a specific location (arg1), by name. A list of valid teleport locations is provided elsewhere.

TELEPORT_TO_OBJECT.desc: teleport beside a specific object (arg1). 'arg1' should be the UUID of the object to teleport to.

DISCOVERY_FEED_GET_UPDATES.desc: read the latest status updates on discovery feed

DISCOVERY_FEED_GET_POST_BY_ID.desc: read a specific post on discovery feed (arg1). 'arg1' should be the integer ID of the post.
